BPSC AES Result 2026 Declared: Check Scores and Updates

Overview of BPSC AES Recruitment 2025-2026

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has reportedly released the result for the Assistant Environmental Scientist (AES) recruitment examination on its official portal. Candidates who appeared for the test can now verify their status through the designated online login mechanism.

According to reported details, the written examination for this recruitment cycle was conducted on 11 June 2026. The initial application window opened on 27 August 2025 and concluded on 19 September 2025.

Key Recruitment Details

  • Issuing Authority: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC)
  • Notification ID / Post Name: Assistant Environmental Scientist (AES)
  • Application Timeline: 27 August 2025 to 19 September 2025
  • Exam Date: 11 June 2026
  • Result Status: Reported available online
  • Vacancies: Not specified
  • Application Fees: Not specified
  • Age Limit: Maximum age reported up to 40 years for Female UR, BC/EBC-Male & Female; up to 42 years for SC/ST-Male & Female, with applicable relaxations per rules.
  • Eligibility Criteria: Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Life Science, Environmental Science, or Physics from a recognized institution.
  • Selection Stages: Written Examination and subsequent result declaration stages.

How to Check the Result

  1. Navigate to the official BPSC website at bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
  2. Locate the "Examination / Result" or "Latest Notices" section on the homepage.
  3. Search for the link pertaining to the Assistant Environmental Scientist (AES) Result 2026.
  4. Enter your login credentials, such as Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.
  5. View and download your result for future reference.

Candidates are strongly advised to cross-verify all notifications, marks, and updates directly from the official BPSC web portal to ensure absolute accuracy.
